title: startup checks do not validate all secretx URIs
description: run_startup_checks in both transit and reader validates secretx URI syntax only for tls.key_path and operator.signing_key_path. admin.bearer_token (transit), admin.admin_token (reader), pinning.external_services[*].api_key (transit), and auth.credential_file (reader) are resolved AFTER the check_only exit, so the preflight validation misses them. An operator running the binary with --check before deploying gets no errors even if these URIs are malformed or point to inaccessible secrets.
